name: Gray magician
source:
???
A mysterious man aboard the "Flying Pussyfoot" whose entire body is covered in gray bandages. He carries a bag filled with bottles and equipment.

[spoiler]Real profile:
Surgeon.
A man simply referred to as "Gray magician." A surgeon. He welcomes one of the "white-clothed members" as an assistant.[/spoiler]

[Translated from in-game profile]

[spoiler]The player is misled to believe he is Maiza's friend, an Immortal, during the "Local" route.[/spoiler]
